description: This file defines serializers, surrogate types, and copiers for the ImmutableSortedSet<T> collection in the Orleans serialization framework. It includes a serializer class, a surrogate data structure, and a deep copier to handle copying of immutable sorted sets.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedSetCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer class for ImmutableSortedSet<T>, converting it to and from a surrogate for serialization purposes.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedSetSurrogate<T>
classes.description: A surrogate type holding data necessary to serialize an ImmutableSortedSet<T>, including its values and key comparer.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedSetCopier<T>
classes.description: A deep copier that creates immutable sorted set copies, with support for shallow copying where appropriate.

methods.name: ImmutableSortedSetCodec<T>.ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate object back into an ImmutableSortedSet<T> instance.

methods.name: ImmutableSortedSetCodec<T>.ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ImmutableSortedSet<T> into its surrogate form for serialization.

methods.name: ImmutableSortedSetCopier<T>.DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an ImmutableSortedSet<T>, utilizing a copier for element copying and handling cyclic references.
